UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and business settings for a Kigali bar/shop owner or Bralirwa distributor.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Full display name of the user.

businessName.description: Name of the bar, shop, or Bralirwa distribution depot.

phone.description: Optional Rwanda contact phone number (private to owner).

DeliveryOrder.title: DeliveryOrder
DeliveryOrder.description: Real-time Bralirwa beverage delivery order with route optimization, live GPS tracking, digital payment settlement, and proof of delivery.

barOwnerId.description: UID of the bar or shop owner placing the commande.

barAddressNote.description: Landmark or street note in Kigali.

distributorId.description: UID of the assigned Bralirwa distributor (empty while PENDING).

distributorName.description: Display name of the assigned distributor.

depotName.description: Nearest Kigali Bralirwa depot fulfilling the order.

driverLat.description: Current live latitude of the delivery vehicle.

driverLng.description: Current live longitude of the delivery vehicle.

itemsSummary.description: Formatted breakdown of Bralirwa crates ordered.

totalAmountRwf.description: Total order value in Rwandan Francs (RWF).

paymentMethod.description: Digital or cash settlement method upon delivery.

paymentReference.description: Digital payment receipt or MoMo transaction reference.

etaMinutes.description: Traffic-aware estimated time of arrival in minutes.

recipientName.description: Name of the person accepting delivery.

signatureCaptured.description: Whether recipient digital signature was captured.

photoVerified.description: Whether delivery crate photo proof was uploaded.

photoCaption.description: Optional note attached to verification photo.

photoThumbnailBase64.description: Compressed Base64 JPEG thumbnail for cross-device POD verification.

deliveredAt.description: Optional server timestamp when delivery acceptance completed.

OrderStatusEvent.title: OrderStatusEvent
OrderStatusEvent.description: Immutable timestamped status update and notification audit entry for an order.

actorId.description: UID of the party who triggered the update.

participantUids.description: Denormalized participant UIDs (max 2) for flat authorization.

DeliveryRating.title: DeliveryRating
DeliveryRating.description: Post-delivery personnel performance rating submitted by the bar owner after order completion.

orderId.description: Completed delivery order ID (matches document ID).

barOwnerId.description: UID of the bar owner submitting the rating.

barName.description: Name of the bar or shop.

distributorName.description: Display name of the rated distributor.

punctualityStars.description: Timeliness and route efficiency rating from 1 to 5.

handlingStars.description: Product and crate handling rating from 1 to 5.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-private business profile and Kigali location settings.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Real-time Bralirwa delivery orders shared between bar owner and assigned distributor.

/orders/{orderId}/events/{eventId}.description: Immutable delivery status updates and notification audit events.

/ratings/{orderId}.description: One-per-order post-delivery rating for delivery personnel.
